title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
summary: The tenant-wide scope assigned to the next-best-action control is not established by Microsoft's documentation, which describes selected experience profiles. The admin paths, Dataverse update calls, opt-in default and billing prerequisites are supported; the quota discussion also needs to acknowledge Microsoft's different guidance for pay-as-you-go overage.
